title: Setup: the permission-set detail header shows the English label under zh-CN, and the metadata list pages (Positions, Permission Sets, …) stay English under ja-JP and es-ES
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a reproduction**. Found by the HotCRM full browser pass objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320 on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0: track 5 Setup (report comment 6442758420 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding D6, D7; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-ptkrz3` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/5-setup/`). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`), which re-read each finding against its screenshot. Batch-of: hotcrm#2320 platform findings.

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` public door: the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0, measured in Chromium against the HotCRM seed.

## What is seen

1. **zh-CN, permission-set detail.** Setup → 权限集 lists the set as 销售代表; opening it, the header reads **"Sales Representative"** (`53-zh-admin-01-permset-list.png`, `52-zh-07-setup-permset-sales-rep.png`).
2. **ja-JP and es-ES, metadata lists.** Setup → Positions under 日本語 or Español reads "Position · create-only · 19 items · New · All sources · All", and the column headers, "None" and "Artifact" stay English (`54-ja-03-setup-positions.png`, `55-es-03-setup-positions.png`). The Setup sidebar and HotCRM's own position labels are translated, and zh-CN translates the same page (岗位 · 仅可新建 · 19 个条目 · 新建 · 全部来源, `52-zh-06-setup-positions.png`).

**Who loses:** admins in those locales, on the pages they configure access from.

## Expected

The detail header uses the translated label the list already shows; the metadata list chrome has ja-JP and es-ES catalog entries as it has zh-CN ones.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` objectstack "Setup metadata list untranslated ja-JP es-ES permission set detail header English label": 10 hits — #26094 (closed, the built-in sets' labels under zh-CN), #25652 (closed, the bundle key for positions and permission sets, which is why the list now translates), #20666, #20653, #20493 (closed, ja-JP/es-ES bundle leaves). None is the detail header or the metadata list chrome on 18.2.0.

**Reader who acts:** the console Setup owner (`domain:ui`, `area:i18n`).
